Chapter 711: Chapter 14: The Theory of Heaven’s Gate (Please Subscribe)

“Low-dimensional space?”

Lin Yuan looked solemn.

According to the Six-Armed Silhouette’s description of “low-dimensional space,”

Lin Yuan was almost certain that the “White Paper” was the “low-dimensional space.”

“Master, did you encounter the ‘low-dimensional space’?” the Six-Armed Silhouette asked curiously.

‘Low-dimensional space’ involves exploring even lower dimensions; even Xuanhuang had not obtained a complete low-dimensional space in the past.

...

The Chaos Void had gone through several Cosmic Eras, and too many strange treasures had vanished into the past.

Such treasures as ‘low-dimensional spaces’ might only be found deep within those large perilous places.

It was only possible, as Xuanhuang had explored many such large perilous places during his time, obtaining only some intelligence regarding ‘low-dimensional space.’

As for the real low-dimensional space, he had no chance to see it.

“Not only did I see it,”

“one of my avatars even fell into it,”

Lin Yuan roughly explained the course of events.

He could fully trust the Six-Armed Silhouette and had no need to conceal anything.

“Master, do you mean that along with you, a large number of other powerhouses fell into the low-dimensional space as well?” The Six-Armed Silhouette widened its eyes.

“Yes,”

Lin Yuan nodded, “The number should be more than one hundred million.”

Battlefield A098, a large alien battlefield, usually hosted a large number of powerhouses during regular periods.

Especially since before the arrival of the ‘White Paper,’ various powers were about to trigger intense battlefield activity, continuously mobilizing powerhouses from all quarters.

Lin Yuan roughly estimated that the number of Eleventh Rank powerhouses in this battlefield would exceed three hundred.

There would be up to two hundred thousand at Tenth Rank.

The remaining powerhouses of Eighth and Ninth Ranks combined approached one hundred million.

This was only the actual number of strong beings alone and did not include entities like puppets and so on.

For example, the strong beings of the Insect Race specialized in nurturing a large number of Insect Race Warriors; these warriors lacked independent thought and were not counted as part of the powerhouse numbers.

“One hundred million?”

“How can a mere simplistic space of a low-dimensional world possibly accommodate one hundred million lives instantly?”

The Six-Armed Silhouette was somewhat flabbergasted.

According to the intelligence about ‘low-dimensional space’ that Xuanhuang got, a normal low-dimensional space, whether for entertainment or gambling purposes, could accommodate only very limited numbers of lives at the same time.

At most, it would not exceed one hundred.

As for one hundred million? The heritage and essence of the low-dimensional space were far inferior to the normal Chaos Void; it simply couldn’t support that many lives.

Unless…

The Six-Armed Silhouette’s expression turned grave, “Master, I suspect that the low-dimensional space you fell into is one of the earliest generations of low-dimensional spaces, created by beings close to Perfect Time Beings who paid a tremendous price and exhausted infinite resources.”

The low-dimensional space originated from beings close to Perfect Time Beings exploring dimensions.

The ‘low-dimensional spaces’ that spread later were mere imitations of those original spaces.

“The earliest generation of low-dimensional spaces?”

Lin Yuan appeared slightly puzzled.

“Yes,” the Six-Armed Silhouette spoke, “Regarding the earliest generation of low-dimensional spaces, His Majesty isn’t highly informed, only knowing that they contain opportunities bestowed by beings close to Perfect Time Beings.”

“The life that falls into such a low-dimensional space, as long as it meets the conditions, could receive the bestowed gift,”

the Six-Armed Silhouette spoke.

“How to leave,” Lin Yuan asked the crucial question.

“The method to leave shouldn’t be hard to discover; you just need to explore the low-dimensional space more and you will probably find out,” the Six-Armed Silhouette hesitantly said.

…

Inside the ‘White Paper.’

Lin Yuan still sat cross-legged in that narrow room.

Through exchanges with Xia Qin Supreme Being, Xuanhuang Spirit of the Mysterious Realm, and Stone Statue Shen Ji,

he had the most basic judgement of his current situation.

First, if the Taiyang Divine Spirit were to die within this two-dimensional world, then he would completely lose this Primordial Spirit.

Second, there should be a way to leave, but managing to leave smoothly was not an easy task.

Leaving this low-dimensional space midway would incur severe penalties, and it was highly likely that one would need to defeat other life forms that had fallen in before being able to leave.

Third, as long as certain conditions were met, one could receive the reward from the creator of this two-dimensional world, which is the being close to a Perfect Time Being.

Fourth, the flow of time here was different from the Main Universe, with the rough ratio reaching one hundred to one

In simple terms, as one year passed in the Main Universe, one hundred years would go by in this two-dimensional world.

Lin Yuan’s focus was currently on leaving this two-dimensional world. Whether or not he could retrieve a reward was not within his considerations.

…

“Situated in this two-dimensional world, the means of enhancing strength from the Main Universe are rendered ninety-nine percent obsolete,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In the Main Universe of the Ten Thousand Universe Races, whether it’s Human Civilization or other groups, the enhancement of strength is geared towards the understanding of many rules.

Using the power of rules, one could easily unleash strength far beyond one’s limits.

And once the understanding of rules reached a certain level, one could create an Inner World, leveraging the power of the Inner World to achieve strength enhancement by hundreds or thousands times.

But here?

Rules?

There are no rules.

Inner World?

Lacking the support of spatial dimensions, there is no semblance of creating an Inner World; Lin Yuan’s Inner World was compressed into a piece of paper.

Therefore,

in this world,

there are only two ways to enhance strength.

One is the physical body.

The stronger the body, the stronger the strength.

This is the most primitive comparison of strength.

Secondly, there are skills.

Under absolute power, skills are of little use.

But if the strength is comparable, or the difference is not significant,

the one with superior skills will have a more powerful composite strength.
